title: DOT urges establishment owners to step up water conservation amid El Niño

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Department of Tourism (DOT) in Mimaropa encouraged all tourism establishments in the provinces of Occidental and Oriental Mindoro, Marinduque, Romblon, and Palawan to implement water-saving measures and protect guests and personnel from extreme heat as the El Niño phenomenon threatens water supplies and normal operations. In Advisory No. 2026-10-004, DOT Mimaropa Regional Director Roberto Alabado urged tourism enterprises and industry stakeholders to adopt precautionary steps like repairing water leaks, maintain adequate water storage, monitor water usage, install water-efficient fixtures, and encourage guests to help conserve water — without compromising sanitation, hygiene, and food safety standards.
